_how: Each node is one stretch of talk. 'say' is a list of text boxes. Then either 'choices' (a menu), 'next' (another node), or nothing (the talk ends). Markup: [red]..[/] [yellow] [blue] [gray] [gold] [shake] [wave], ^1-^9 pauses, \n new line. A line can be {"text": "..", "face": "smile", "speed": 60} to swap to art/marquez-smile.png or type slower. A choice can have "needs": "nodeId" (only shows once that node was heard; "!nodeId" means NOT heard yet) and "once": true (hides after it's been picked).  A line wrapped in (parentheses) is narration: no nameplate, in italics. Faces: smile, angry, point. Each face talks on its own using its -talk1/-talk2 art. 'name' is the nameplate; a line or node can set its own \"name\". 'returning' is where he starts for someone who has talked to him before.
name: MARQUEZ

say: (A gentleman sits behind a desk in the dark.)
Not many find their way down here. Fewer still think to knock.
How did you get here, anyway? Well, no, you're here to ask me questions.

say.text: Back again.^2 Good to see you're alive!

say: I wondered if you would be.
How can I help you?
Any other names attract too much noise.
I used to be a shopkeep before everything went to hell. Now I reside where nothing can find me.

say.text: One name at a time, friend.

say: [yellow]Sooner than you think, friend.[/]
We are in the back-backstage![/]^5
[grey] I think, anyway...

say.text: Everything up there is on display.[/]^9 Everything down here is [gold]abandoned[/].

say: Advice.^2 Hm.
Pick a thread and I'll tell you what I can.
That thing has so much to offer! I brought it here from my shop!

say.text: You can do anything you set your mind to with it!

say: Well, I haven't seen that thing in so long, I couldn't tell you with any sort of certainty what it does.
[gray]Unless... [yellow]No, he didn't[/]

say.text: The board! Yes! That's my doing!

say: [gray]I wish I could help you more.[/]
I don't remember anything on that board, I've been here for so long...
[shake][red] E V E R Y T H I N G ! ! ! !
Don't listen to him. Ever! He lies!
[gray]Lies . . .[/]
Did you, now.

say.text: Not yet, I think.^3 Come back when your hands are shaking.

say: You'll know soon enough, young one.[/]

say.text: Try and find the door... It moves a lot!

say: (He settles back into the dark.)
